text:
incident-bot: Pager: unusual auth validation failures and log-forwarder anomaly in eu-west-1 — spike starting ~2024-11-02T00:50Z. Priority P2. @elliot please triage.
elliot (eng-oncall): On it — pulling auth and forwarder logs now.
maya (eng-sre): quick heads-up: seeing repeated 401s tied to client_id=svc-ingest, header x-auth present but truncated in many entries.
elliot (eng-oncall): can you paste a sample?
maya (eng-sre): logged snippet: `"Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJI..."` then later `"Authorization: Bearer "` (empty). looks like log rotation/truncation + some full tokens in s3 paths.
maya (eng-sre): grep shows ~1.2k objects under s3://prod-analytics/tmp-logs/2024-11-02/ containing `Authorization:` strings, a subset have unmasked tokens. Exposure window ~00:50-02:20Z.
rajesh (sec): if tokens are in S3 we need immediate rotation and legal notified. Confirm scope (prod vs staging)?
maya (eng-sre): initial evidence indicates a staging forwarder config accidentally pointed at prod analytics bucket. So prod objects touched.
elliot (eng-oncall): Customer impact? any 5xx/401 user reports?
maya (eng-sre): Host metrics show an uptick in 401s to /v1/generate from a small fraction of callers. Likely related to replay attempts.
elliot (eng-oncall): Immediate plan: 1) Quarantine forwarder pipeline 2) Block suspicious sources at edge 3) Rotate forwarder service creds + any exposed API tokens 4) Snapshot evidence and enable bucket audit 5) Notify legal & support with draft comms.
ops-runner-bot: Action: applying temporary WAF block to suspicious CIDR 185.74.0.0/16 in eu-west-1. rule_id=rw-7182002468-block-src.
ops-runner-bot: WAF rule applied. propagation ~20s.
maya (eng-sre): also seeing repeated replay from 185.74.23.202. tagging that IP for PCAP capture.
elliot (eng-oncall): runbook step: snapshot relevant bucket objects to evidence store. maya, can you run the copy?
maya (eng-sre): running: `aws s3 cp s3://prod-analytics/tmp-logs/ s3://evidence-7182002468/ --recursive --exclude "*" --include "*2024-11-02*"` — starting now.
ops-runner-bot: Snapshot job started: snap-7182002468. ETA ~6m.
rajesh (sec): starting credential rotation for forwarder svc account. Will create new creds and revoke old. Pushing to Vault path secret/prod/forwarder/rot-7182002468.
ops-runner-bot: Rotation job initiated: job-id=7182002468-rot1.
rajesh (sec): old key revoked. invalidation pushed to caches. please verify downstream consumers.
maya (eng-sre): capturing k8s logs for forensics: `kubectl -n ingress logs deploy/auth-proxy --since=3h > /tmp/auth-proxy-logs-7182002468.txt` — saved.
elliot (eng-oncall): support draft in #support-drafts: short acknowledgment that we observed transient auth failures and are investigating; rotating keys as precaution. No confirmed customer data exfiltration yet.
zoe (legal): Legal intake: treat as potential exposure of credentials. Need full list of affected objects, tenant mapping for each object, timeline, and mitigation steps. Preparing hold notice template.
maya (eng-sre): rough counts: 1.2k objects touched, ~430 objects with clear token patterns, ~70 unique tenant_ids referenced in logs.
rajesh (sec): I identified replay attempts using one token pattern. Blocking and throttling in place. Also enabled additional audit logging on prod-analytics bucket and created snapshot access audit.
ops-runner-bot: Audit logging enabled on s3://prod-analytics. evidence snapshot archived at s3://evidence-7182002468/ (restricted).
maya (eng-sre): extracting tenant mapping now and saving CSV to evidence bucket.
elliot (eng-oncall): handoff: I'll hand incident to @rajesh at 03:30Z for monitoring, legal coordination, and support comms. I'll continue postmortem write-up after stabilization.
rajesh (sec): taking over now. I'll monitor logs for 6 hours, coordinate with Zoe for compliance timeline, and work with Support for customer notifications.
zoe (legal): please DM me the tenant CSV and list of affected buckets. We'll prioritize customers with high-sensitivity data.
elliot (eng-oncall): status update: mitigations applied (WAF blocks, forwarder quarantined, creds rotated), further validation ongoing.
ops-runner-bot: Incident state -> partial_mitigation. tags=[blocked-ip, rotated-keys, quarantined-forwarder, evidence-snapshot].
maya (eng-sre): followup actions: 1) audit forwarder configs org-wide 2) add masking enforcement in forwarder agent 3) add CI check to prevent prod bucket targets in staging configs.
rajesh (sec): security follow-ups noted. I'll open a backlog epic and assign owners.
elliot (eng-oncall): thanks team. If anything urgent, page me. Otherwise I'll file the incident and schedule a blameless postmortem.
rajesh (sec): will escalate to infra and data teams for broader config guardrails.
ops-runner-bot: Incident timeline updated. last_action_ts=7182003720.

[END THREAD]
